attr.descriptionViolation: The individual concerned violated Article 16 of the Authority’s Board Decision No. (2) of 2001 on the Regulation of Trading, Clearing, Settlement, Transfer of Ownership, and Custody of Securities by executing trades with the intent of influencing the price and volume of a listed security.

The individual concerned violated Article 16 of the Authority’s Board Decision No. (2) of 2001 on the Regulation of Trading, Clearing, Settlement, Transfer of Ownership, and Custody of Securities by executing trades with the intent of influencing the price and volume of a listed security.

The company violated Article 2 of Chapter 1 of Section 2 of the Authority’s Board Chairman’s Decision No. (13/Chairman) of 2021 Concerning the Rulebook for Financial Activities and Status Adjustment Mechanisms. Specifically, it operated beyond the scope of its license by collaborating with an unlicensed foreign entity and holding itself out to investors as authorized to conduct brokerage activities in the UAE.
